sections.description: Company standard membership plugin for WordPress projects built by Circea: one members table to approve, deny, deactivate and reactivate members.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • The members table looks the same on Bricks sites as on Etch. Bricks' base styles made the column checkboxes and "Per page" light gray and set them off the line, pushed the search under the role filter and drew a second arrow in the selects.
  • The search runs by itself 400 ms after typing stops, once it has at least 3 characters, and emptying it shows everyone again; Enter still runs it at any length, for example for a short user ID. After the page reloads, the cursor stays at the end of the search, and letters typed while it loaded are kept and searched.
  • A Reset filters button after the search, shown while a role or a search is set, goes back to the same view and page size without them. On phones, the role filter, the search and Reset filters each fill their own row.
  • The columns are now First Name, Last Name, Email, Registered, Status, Roles, Details, Actions, Last Login, Username and User ID, and First Name stays at the left while the table scrolls sideways. Roles, Username and User ID start hidden, like Last Login: their checkboxes show them, and the details dialog lists them either way, in the table's order.
  • With the Small interface scale, the message above the table and the text of an empty table are small too.
  • New icons for the select chevrons and the reset button.

1.0.1

  • Activating or deactivating the license now brings you back to the License tab of the settings page instead of the Settings tab. The bundled SureCart SDK lost the tab when it redirected after the license form.

1.0.0

  • First stable release. The member roles, Member Reviewer, the mac_members_review capability, the [mac_members_table] shortcode, the settings and the mac_members_ filters keep their names from now on.
  • Deleting the plugin with "Delete plugin data" on no longer removes the member roles or Member Reviewer, even when no user holds them. A registration form or the default role for new users may still name Member (Pending), and a role that no longer exists shows there as another one: WS Form shows Administrator, and the next save of the form stores it. The settings page no longer lists how many users hold each member role.
  • The Documentation links on the Plugins screen and in the Support tab open the Circea docs home page, like MAC Core's, so a change in the docs' structure can't break them.
  • Requires WordPress 6.9 or later, like MAC Core.
  • The repository is public. Each release ships a SHA-256 checksum and a build provenance attestation.

0.5.1

  • WordPress no longer shows MAC Members updates as "Not tested" with its version: release.json names the full WordPress version the release was tested on, 7.1.2.
  • A release tested on a WordPress branch counts as tested on every patch release of that branch, the way wordpress.org reads "Tested up to", so a WordPress patch release doesn't bring "Not tested" back. MAC Core does the same since 1.3.1.

0.5.0

  • The Plugins screen links to Settings and License next to Deactivate, and to Support and Documentation next to View details, like MAC Core.
  • A Support tab on the settings page, with the support email and a link to the MAC Members documentation.
  • A Member Reviewer role, mac_members_reviewer, with only mac_members_review, to add on top of a reviewer's own role. Activation creates it, and sites that update get it on the next request. "Delete plugin data" removes it when nobody holds it.
  • The bundled SureCart licensing SDK reads only its own mac_members_ global names, like MAC Core's mac_core_ ones, so a value set for another plugin's copy of the SDK never changes MAC Members' licensing.

0.4.0

  • License and updates through SureCart, like MAC Core: enter the license key in the new License tab of the settings page, and WordPress offers new versions under Dashboard > Updates.
  • Bundles the SureCart licensing SDK v1.2.1 in the MAC Members namespace, with the patch that keeps it from adding its own menu page.
  • Update URI points to a Circea host, so no other updater plugin can supply MAC Members.
  • "Delete plugin data" also removes the stored license and the cached update details.
  • Sites on 0.3.0 or older need this update once by hand; later versions come from SureCart.

0.3.0

  • [mac_members_table] replaces [mac_members_pending_table]: one members table with a filter and a count for each status, a role filter, a search, pages of 24, 48, 96 or 192 members and a checkbox for each column.
  • An inactive status and four status changes: approve, deny, deactivate and reactivate. A member holds one status role at a time, and nobody is deleted.
  • The plugin always uses its own four roles: mac_members_pending, mac_members_approved, mac_members_inactive and mac_members_denied. The settings that chose other roles are gone.
  • A member details modal with extra fields from the settings and the member's status buttons.
  • The settings page has three sections: Interface, Emails and Plugin. Reactivation sends its own emails, and admin emails no longer link to the profile screen.
  • mac_members_review works as a narrow promote_users. Users with administrative capabilities are hidden from the table and never changed.

0.2.0

  • First release: settings, the pending members table, approve and deny, and notification emails.
sections.frequently asked questions:
How do I manage my license?

Open the MAC Members settings page, go to the License tab and enter the license key provided through SureCart.
